name: The Beastmaster Princess
source:
The Beastmaster Princess is a fantasy visual novel featuring a diverse cast, branching plot and several different endings. It takes place in the fantasy world of Aravorn, already seen in games like Loren The Amazon Princess and Cursed Lands.

This is the story of Kunya, the child of Chief Goro, leader of the Desert Snakes tribe. Kunya is a formidable warrior and a future warchief. But even the most formidable need allies.

Kunya can count on Luna's motherly cures. There isn't a single thing the shaman can't fix with her potions.

On the battlefield, there's no better ally than Takara. Brave and hot-headed, she's always looking to gain more fame and recognition so that her name will be remembered by future generations.

Though older than the others, Manila is no less dangerous in a fight. She may be a lone wolf, but she's always willing to share her wisdom and experience.

With Lyara about to marry an elven prince, the tribe is in disorder.
As a half-elf abandoned in the desert as a child, she has always struggled to fit in with the other nomads despite being adopted as Goro's daughter.
Perhaps this marriage can return her to her elven roots.

Unfortunately, events conspire against this union. As Prince Merril travels to meet Lyara, his caravan is assaulted by dark elves and he is nowhere to be found in the aftermath.

Now it's up to Kunya and the others to track him down. They'll face numerous dangers, using force and cunning to overcome them. In doing so, perhaps Kunya will discover love along with the hidden power of Lyara, the beastmaster princess.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2150020/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《兽王公主》是一部奇幻视觉小说，具有多元化的演员阵容、分支情节和多个不同的结局。它发生在阿拉文的奇幻世界中，这一点已经在《亚马逊公主洛伦》和《诅咒之地》等游戏中出现过。

这是沙漠蛇部落首领五郎酋长的孩子库尼亚的故事。库尼亚是一位强大的战士，也是未来的大酋长。但即使是最强大的国家也需要盟友。

库尼亚可以信赖卢娜的慈母般的治疗方法。萨满的魔药没有什么不能解决的。

在战场上，没有比宝更好的盟友了。勇敢而头脑发热的她总是希望获得更多的名声和认可，以便她的名字能够被子孙后代所铭记。

尽管马尼拉比其他城市年长，但在战斗中危险性却丝毫不减。她可能是一匹孤独的狼，但她总是愿意分享她的智慧和经验。

莱雅拉即将嫁给一位精灵王子，部落陷入混乱。
作为一个小时候被遗弃在沙漠中的半精灵，尽管她被收养为戈罗的女儿，但她一直很难融入其他游牧民族。
也许这次婚姻可以让她回归精灵的根源。

不幸的是，一些事件密谋反对这个联盟。当梅里尔王子前往与莱雅拉会面时，他的商队遭到了黑暗精灵的袭击，之后他就不知去向了。

现在轮到库尼亚和其他人来追踪他了。他们将面临无数危险，并使用武力和狡猾来克服它们。在这样做的过程中，也许库尼亚会发现爱情以及兽王公主莱雅拉隐藏的力量。
